## Description

Implements the synergy-red-team activity (S3): audits the assumption register behind a synergy score for optimism bias and reference-class (base-rate) deviation. Does not draft the assumptions and does not set the score. Use when: "assumption audit", "assumption review", "assumption register check", "optimism bias check".
